setup: Target: Todmorden 02HC024 daily mean >= 20 m3/s today or tomorrow. Train 2000-2015, alert threshold picked on 2016-2019, scored once on 2020-2023 (1460 days, 44 positive days, 20 high-water events). Rain = mean of ECCC stations 6158355, 615S001, 6158733/6158731. Other weather = Open-Meteo archive at 43.75,-79.37. Next-day rain is the measured value (a perfect forecast); live forecasts will be worse.

weatherPlusGaugeModel.note: Adding yesterday's river flow did not improve event catches at Watch or Warning, so the app ships the weather-only model and shows the gauge separately.

rainSourceNote: First attempt used grid rain only and caught far fewer summer floods: the grid shows 12 mm on 2013-07-08 when Pearson logged 126 mm.
